items.title: BESS and BESS-hybrids updates
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has amended the Code to correct the date when amended clause 13.12 takes effect for wholesale market arrangements for battery energy storage systems.

items.title: New members for Distribution Connection Pricing Technical Group
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has announced 13 appointees to its Distribution Connection Pricing Technical Group following a call for nominations.

items.title: Electricity Authority Te Mana Hiko Annual report 2025/26 published
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has released its Annual report for 2025/26 covering its work making and enforcing electricity market rules.

items.title: Authority confirms Code changes relating to the Consumer Care Obligations and AUFLS compliance
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has decided on three amendments to the Electricity Industry Participation Code relating to Part 11A Consumer Care and automatic under-frequency load shedding compliance.

items.title: Survey highlights opportunity to help more consumers find better power deals
items.summary: The Electricity Authority's latest Residential Consumer Sentiment Survey results focus on how easily consumers can compare power options and find better deals.

items.title: Baseload market making changes from March 2027
items.summary: From 1 March 2027, market makers must provide quotes for quarterly baseload electricity futures on the ASX out to five years ahead, up from three years at present.

items.title: Clean Energy Council Annual General Meeting 2026
items.summary: The Clean Energy Council's 18th AGM runs 3.30–4.30pm AEDT on 25 November 2026, in person at 180 Lonsdale St Melbourne and online. Members vote on three board director positions and constitutional changes; pre-voting closes 5pm AEDT 24 November.

items.title: Foresighting Forum 2027: Leading the Charge
items.summary: Energy Consumers Australia's national consumer energy conference runs 24–25 February 2027 at the Sofitel Sydney Wentworth, covering affordability, reliability and equity for households and small businesses. Early bird registration rates close 14 December 2026.

items.title: EV Charging Infrastructure Australia 2027
items.summary: Fifth annual two-day forum on 1–2 February 2027 in Melbourne on EV charging deployment, covering grid connection constraints, smart charging, distributed energy, V2G and fleet electrification across energy, fleet, property and technology sectors.

items.title: Joint media release: Cheaper, cleaner energy for South Australia's apartment residents
items.source: DCCEEW (Minister for Climate Change and Energy)
items.summary: The Albanese and Malinauskas governments announced a $17.8 million package on 15 November 2026 to help South Australian apartment residents install shared solar and battery systems.

items.title: EnergyAustralia fined $750,000 for alleged failure to provide grid stability services
items.summary: AER media release on infringement notices totalling $750,000 issued to EnergyAustralia for alleged failure to provide contracted grid stability services.

items.title: AER publishes exemptions guidelines review final decision
items.summary: AER has published its final decision from the review of its exemptions guidelines, which set out when network and retail obligations under the national energy rules do not apply.

items.title: Stress test disclosures due by 23 December 2026
items.summary: The Electricity Authority reminds wholesale market participants subject to the spot price risk (stress testing) regime that their quarterly financial exposure disclosures are due by 23 December 2026.

items.title: National Hydrogen Regulatory Review – Public Consultation on National Hydrogen Regulatory Guidebook: Hydrogen Freight by Road
items.summary: DCCEEW is seeking feedback on a complete draft of the National Hydrogen Regulatory Guidebook covering hydrogen freight by road, as part of the National Hydrogen Regulatory Review. Submissions close 16 November 2026.

items.title: Climate Change Minister heads to COP 31
items.summary: Climate Change Minister Simon Watts is travelling to Antalya, Türkiye for the 31st UN Climate Change Summit (COP31) to represent New Zealand's national and regional interests.

items.title: Implementation of the ECGS PASA, ERSAA and SoLR rule changes
items.summary: AEMO consultation on implementing East Coast Gas System procedures for the PASA, emergency reserves (ERSAA) and supplier of last resort rule changes. Submissions close 10 December 2026.

items.title: Transpower engineering panel to grow workforce capability and improve value for consumers
items.summary: Transpower has appointed a panel of engineering design consultancies to build specialist workforce capability for its infrastructure programme and improve procurement efficiency.

items.title: Speech by Dr John Small: National Lifeline Utilities Forum
items.summary: Commerce Commission Chair Dr John Small spoke on resilience as a form of insurance, covering how regulators, infrastructure providers and communities can support investment that reduces future disruption.

items.title: New guidance to support commissioning of large load
items.summary: Transpower's System Operator has published technical guideline GL-EA-1370 for commissioning large loads of 10 MW or more, covering modelling, testing and information requirements. A System Security Forecast, including data centre sensitivities, is due in December 2026.

items.title: AEMC determination strengthens framework to address anticipated data centre impacts on the national electricity grid
items.summary: AEMC published the final rule from its Improving the NEM Access Standards review, introducing stronger obligations on large data centres connecting to the grid. The rule was published on 11 November 2026.

items.title: 25/26-134 Tuparikino Hub - EV Charging Infrastructure Partnership
items.summary: New Plymouth District Council tender (RFx 35469133) for an EV charging infrastructure partnership at the Tuparikino Hub. Open 10 November 2026; closes 9 December 2026.

items.title: Sydney Policy Lunch | Powering Australia's Next Decade
items.summary: Australian Energy Council policy lunch in Sydney on 23 February 2027, 11:30am–2:30pm, where senior industry leaders discuss market reform, investment and project delivery across Australia's energy markets.

items.title: AEPC_2026_16 Dispatch Compliance
items.summary: WEM Procedure Change Proposal AEPC_2026_16 amends the Dispatch Compliance procedure and commenced on 1 October 2026. It is one of a batch of AEMO procedure changes (including Reserve Capacity Security, Reserve Capacity Testing and dispatch of demand side programmes) that took effect with the new ESM Rules.

items.title: Provision of Minimum System Load Transitional Services (NEM-wide)
items.summary: AEMO is running an NEM-wide procurement for minimum system load transitional services, listed among its current tenders. The tender page carries the scope, eligibility and submission arrangements, including the closing date.

items.title: Data centres to bring clean, firm energy, be flexible and pay their way, AEMC advises Ministers
items.summary: The AEMC has advised energy ministers that data centres should bring their own clean firmed energy, operate flexibly and connect efficiently, as part of a package of reforms following its data centre work program. The recommendations shape how large new loads pay for and underpin network and generation investment.

items.title: Electricity Flexibility Solutions - Queenstown Area
items.summary: Aurora Energy has an open registration of interest inviting flexibility providers to offer demand-side and distributed solutions in the Queenstown area as an alternative to network investment. Registrations remain open until 29 December 2028.

items.title: SEANZ Webinar - New Standards Round Up
items.summary: SEANZ is running an online standards round-up webinar covering recent changes relevant to solar, battery and stand-alone power system installers. Scheduled for 25 November 2026.

items.title: New guidance supports power companies to take a precautionary approach to protecting medically dependent consumers
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has published guidance asking power companies to take a precautionary approach when identifying, recording and protecting medically dependent consumers.

items.title: Draft decision to allow $1.3b investment in Canterbury electricity network
items.summary: The Commerce Commission's draft decision on Orion's customised price-quality path approves about $1.3b of the $1.5b proposed for 2027–2032, which would add around $21 a month to an average Orion customer's bill by 2032. Submissions close 8 December 2026 and cross-submissions 23 December 2026, with a final decision expected in March 2027.

items.title: Participants' In-Person Forum - 12 November 2026
items.summary: Transpower is holding an in-person participants' forum in Wellington on 12 November, with sessions on TSO-DSO coordination operating requirements and on low residual situations, including lessons from the 6 August 2026 record peak and how the new emergency reserve will fit in. RSVPs closed 4 November.

items.title: Infrastructure Regulation Symposium
items.summary: ENA's first Infrastructure Regulation Symposium, supported by the Commerce Commission, is a full-day in-person event at Rydges Wellington. It will cover investment, affordability and the future of regulation across electricity, gas and other infrastructure sectors. Tickets are $950 plus GST.

items.title: New Zealand Power Summit 2026
items.summary: A two-day summit at the Grand Millennium Auckland on supply adequacy, declining gas, grid-scale storage, network reinforcement and market reform. Speakers include the Commerce Commission, Meridian, Genesis, Transpower and Powerco.

items.title: Energy Trader Forum – 9 December 2026
items.summary: The third Energy Trader Forum of 2026 is a half-day meeting at the Grand Millennium Auckland for energy and carbon market traders, regulators and large users, held under the Chatham House Rule. Attendance is limited to members and approved guests, and remote access is available.

items.title: Downstream 2027
items.summary: Downstream, New Zealand's main energy-industry conference, will be held at Tākina in Wellington on 10–11 March 2027. Topics include network performance, distributed energy, retail, regulated markets, emissions and technology; the 2026 event drew more than 570 delegates.

items.title: Draft Transmission System Plan 2026 – invitation for feedback
items.summary: Western Power wants feedback from consumers and industry on its draft 2026 Transmission System Plan, which sets out proposed SWIS transmission development over the next decade under the ESM Rules. Submissions close 12 November 2026, and Western Power will publish summaries of submissions along with its responses.

items.title: Cook Labor Government powering ahead with clean energy workforce training
items.summary: BADGE Constructions has won the tender to build a clean energy training facility at South Metropolitan TAFE's Munster campus, and work is underway on the $32 million Midland Clean Energy Skills Hub. The government estimates WA will need about 22,000 extra clean energy workers by 2035.

items.title: On-Farm Energy and Electrification Demonstration Program VIC
items.summary: Grants of $200,000 to $750,000 are available to demonstrate on-farm energy efficiency, renewable generation and storage technologies in Victoria. Applications close on 11 December 2026.

items.title: EV Kerbside Charging Grants - Round 3
items.source: NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
items.summary: Round 3 of the Drive Electric NSW EV kerbside charging grants is open for applications. Submissions close at 5pm AEDT on 21 December 2026.

items.title: Electricity Network Regulation Review (ENRR) – package 1 - Hybrid forum
items.summary: The AEMC is holding a hybrid forum (Sheraton Melbourne and online) on 19 November, 10.30 am to 3.00 pm AEDT, on its analysis and possible policy options for package 1 of the Electricity Network Regulation Review, covering which network services should be regulated and how costs are allocated. Registration closes COB Friday 13 November, and in-person places may close earlier if the venue fills.

items.title: Energy Club WA - November Industry Lunch
items.summary: Energy Club WA's November Industry Lunch will be held at Anzac House, 28 St Georges Tce, Perth on 20 November 2026, 11.30 am to 3.00 pm. Registration is open, with tickets from $120 (young professionals) to $200 (non-members).

items.title: Energy Club WA - Industry Christmas Sundowner
items.summary: Energy Club WA's end-of-year industry networking sundowner will be held at Faraday's Perth, 216 St Georges Tce, on 9 December 2026 from 5.00 pm to 8.00 pm. Registration is open.

items.title: Introduction to the Future Energy System Outlook (IEEE WA webinar)
items.summary: Energy Policy WA analyst Adnan Hayat will introduce WA's Future Energy System Outlook at a free one-hour IEEE WA online seminar on 18 November 2026, 5.00 pm to 6.00 pm AWST. No registration is needed, and Teams access details are posted on the IEEE WA events page.

items.title: Consultation on Western Australia’s adoption of the National Gas Law – Other Gases Package
items.summary: DEED is consulting on draft instruments to adopt the Other Gases Package in WA, which extends the National Gas Access (WA) Law to covered gases such as hydrogen, biomethane and synthetic methane. Feedback is sought on implementation issues only, as national Energy Ministers have already agreed the policy.

items.title: Draft AES Compliance and Enforcement Guide
items.summary: The ERA is consulting on a draft guide that sets out how it will promote, monitor and enforce compliance with the alternative electricity services (AES) framework. AES registration holders should review it before the final guide is published.

items.title: AER publishes gas transmission data for the 2025 regulatory year
items.summary: The AER has published gas transmission pipeline data for the 2025 regulatory year.

items.title: AER publishes 2028-33 revised reference service proposals for Victorian gas distribution networks
items.summary: The AER has published revised reference service proposals from the Victorian gas distribution networks for the 2028–33 access arrangement period. These proposals feed into the upcoming gas network reset.

items.title: AER makes determination on Transgrid’s System Security Roadmap Operational Technology contingent project application
items.summary: The AER has made its determination on Transgrid's contingent project application for operational technology under its System Security Roadmap. The decision affects Transgrid's allowed revenue and NSW transmission charges.

items.title: AER publishes decision on proposed tariff structure statement amendments by Ergon Energy and Energex
items.summary: The AER has published its decision on amendments that Ergon Energy and Energex proposed to their tariff structure statements, which affect Queensland network tariffs.

items.title: AER updates the Better Resets Handbook
items.summary: The AER has updated its Better Resets Handbook, which sets out its expectations for consumer engagement in network businesses' regulatory proposals.

items.title: Australia and Denmark Strengthen Climate and Clean Energy Cooperation
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: Australia and Denmark signed a Memorandum of Understanding at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, setting up a Climate and Energy Partnership aimed at clean energy cooperation and economic opportunities.

items.title: Improving coordination between Gas Pipeline Operators and the Australian Energy Market Operator
items.summary: This is part of the Coordinator of Energy's review of the Gas Services Information Rules and deals with coordination between gas pipeline operators and AEMO. The review follows the WA Domestic Gas Policy Inquiry and planned changes to the National Gas Law.

items.title: Outdoor Disconnector and Earth Switch Refurbishment (SUP-18004)
items.summary: Transpower is seeking registrations of interest from suppliers that can fabricate components and install refurbished outdoor disconnectors and earth switches, to extend the life of these grid assets. The registration of interest opened on 9 November 2026 and closes at 3pm on 4 December 2026.

items.title: December 2026 Minor Amendment Consultation
items.summary: AEMO has started a minor amendment consultation on the MSATS Procedures: Principles and Obligations for All Connection Points (v8.14) to fix minor omissions and errors. Submissions close 5pm Melbourne time on 24 November 2026.

items.title: Cook Labor Government $15m boost for large-scale batteries
items.summary: Australian Vanadium Limited has been awarded $15 million from the Investment Attraction Fund New Energies Industries Round 2 to set up a relocatable vanadium electrolyte manufacturing facility in WA. The facility will supply vanadium flow batteries for grid-scale, long-duration storage.

items.title: Marri Wind Farm - Application for an electricity generation licence - Invitation for public submissions
items.summary: The ERA is seeking comment on a generation licence application from Marri WF Pty Ltd (owned by Alinta Energy) for a 550 MW wind farm of up to 82 turbines, about 20 km south of Dandaragan and connecting to the SWIS. The project was designated a state priority project in June 2026.

items.title: Consultation on Rule Change RC_2026_01 – Release of Reserve Capacity Security once Reserve Capacity Obligations commence
items.summary: Tesla Holdings has proposed a WEM rule change so that Reserve Capacity Security is released once Reserve Capacity Obligations commence. It is following the standard process, with the first submission period open to 21 December 2026 and a draft report due by 21 January 2027.

items.title: News Bulletin 6 November 2026
items.summary: Gas Industry Co's November bulletin covers the 2026 Co-regulatory Forum, updates to gas information exchange protocols, its September 2026 quarterly report and the revised consultation calendar.

items.title: Lincoln University - Supply of Electricity
items.summary: Lincoln University RFP for purchase of electricity supply to its Canterbury and Otago sites. Closes 20 November 2026.

items.title: RIT-D FPAR Pakenham South and Surrounding Areas
items.summary: AusNet's final project assessment report for the Pakenham area RIT-D proposes a new Pakenham South zone substation and three distribution feeders at an estimated capital cost of $72.2 million (real 2025). Parties may dispute the conclusions with the AER by 7 December 2026.

items.title: Australia to advance practical action on climate change at COP31
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: Minister Chris Bowen is leading Australia's delegation and international climate negotiations at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye.

items.title: IPRR implementation changes (ERC0458)
items.summary: AEMC has opened consultation on AEMO's requests to defer full IPRR dispatch mode and voluntarily scheduled resource incentive payments from May 2027 to late 2029, and to publish VSR SCADA data. Submissions on the consultation information sheet close 3 December 2026, with the draft determination extended to 18 February 2027.

items.title: Deep Space Advanced Radar Capability – Alternate Energy Solution (ESTJ9360PH1T2) – Invitation to Register Interest
items.summary: Defence is seeking a managing contractor to deliver a utility-scale solar farm, battery storage and associated electrical/ICT infrastructure to supplement the diesel power station at the Harold E. Holt naval communication station near Exmouth, WA. Registrations close 17 December 2026, with contract award anticipated around June 2027 and completion in 2030.

items.title: Energy Management Services
items.summary: MPI is procuring energy management services across its property portfolio, including invoice verification, dashboards, market analysis and carbon reduction advice, with mobilisation from late January 2027. Proposals close 4 December 2026.

items.title: Squadron Energy Retail Pty Ltd – granted electricity retailer authorisation
items.summary: The AER has granted Squadron Energy Retail Pty Ltd an electricity retailer authorisation, allowing it to sell electricity in the NEM.

items.title: Joint media release: Backing Australian hydrogen innovation to target low-emissions steel
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: Ministers Bowen and Ayres have jointly announced Commonwealth support for Australian hydrogen innovation aimed at producing low-emissions steel.

items.title: Speaker Series and End-Of-Year Gathering
items.summary: NZWEA's final speaker series event and end-of-year gathering for 2026, hosted by Buddle Findlay, brings together wind sector members, regulators and government stakeholders. Held 16 December 2026.

items.title: Joint media release: Queensland leads charge as 30,000 homes cut power bills and take control of their energy use
items.summary: More than 30,000 home energy upgrades have been completed nationally, with Queensland leading uptake under the Commonwealth-backed program. Signals continued federal funding flow into household electrification and demand-side work.

items.title: Funding for research into hydrogen resources
items.summary: The Government will grant up to $17.8 million from the Regional Infrastructure Fund to speed up exploratory research into whether hydrogen resources in Southland are commercially viable.

items.title: Cost of capital determination for disclosure year 2027 for information disclosure regulation – First Gas and Powerco gas pipeline businesses [2026] NZCC 54
items.summary: The Commission set a mid-point vanilla WACC of 6.98% (post-tax 6.33%) for information disclosure by First Gas and Powerco gas pipeline businesses for disclosure year 2027. It reflects the High Court order of August 2026 amending the gas input methodologies.

items.title: Plug in to power up – consultation on legalising plug-in solar and batteries
items.summary: The WA Government plans to legalise plug-in 'balcony' solar and battery systems, and DEED and LGIRS are consulting on a regulatory amendment and draft technical standard. The standard would allow up to 2 kW (DC) of panels and 800 W (AC) inverters, with no cap on storage capacity.

items.title: Amending effective dates to enable industry compliance with metering maintenance obligations
items.summary: The AEMC has received a rule change request (ERC0464) to amend effective dates so industry can comply with metering maintenance obligations. The proposal was received on 9 September 2026 and is at the pending stage.

items.title: Information Session: data centre work program
items.summary: The AEMC is holding an online information session on its data centre work program, which covers five rule changes including Access Standards Package 2 (ERC0394). It runs from 1:00pm to 3:00pm AEDT on 27 November 2026.

items.title: Modernising energy communications to meet consumer needs (Electricity)
items.summary: On 5 November 2026 the AEMC initiated an ECMC-proposed rule change (ERC0463) to modernise how energy businesses communicate with consumers under the electricity rules. It is being considered together with the gas and retail versions (GRC0096, RRC0078).

items.title: Modernising energy communications to meet consumer needs (Gas)
items.summary: On 5 November 2026 the AEMC initiated the gas rules version (GRC0096) of the ECMC's request to modernise how energy businesses communicate with consumers. It is being considered alongside ERC0463 and RRC0078.

items.title: Australian hydrogen technology backed for steelmaking pilot
items.summary: ARENA has committed $15 million to Hadean Energy for a $30 million pilot of an Australian-developed hydrogen technology aimed at cutting the cost of green hydrogen for steelmaking.

items.title: Melbourne battery innovation moves towards local manufacturing with ARENA support
items.summary: ARENA is providing $6.77 million to Clutch Industries for a $19.35 million project to set up a scalable manufacturing line for its portable home battery.

items.title: Bannockburn Industrial Subdivision: Stage 1 - Power Supply
items.summary: Central Otago District Council RFP for design and delivery of the Stage 1 power supply network for the 9.82 ha Bannockburn industrial subdivision near Cromwell, including point of connection and network operator approvals. Responses close 1 December 2026.

items.title: Nelson City Council - ROI - NTRLBU - Waste to Watts Project
items.summary: The Nelson Tasman Regional Landfill Business Unit is seeking registrations of interest for the mechanical, electrical and balance-of-plant package, including landfill gas generators and SCADA integration, for its Waste to Watts generation project. Closes 24 November 2026.

items.title: Electricity Authority releases updated improved billing guidance
items.summary: The Authority has updated its guidance to help retailers put the billing reforms in place by 1 April 2027.

items.title: Why transmission pricing matters in a changing electricity system
items.summary: The Authority explains why the Transmission Pricing Methodology uses a beneficiaries-pay approach and notes it is making targeted refinements to the TPM. Transpower is running a separate TPM Operational Review at the same time.

items.title: Geothermal exploration for Taranaki and Waikato
items.summary: The Regional Infrastructure Fund is backing two Māori-led early geothermal exploration projects in Taranaki and South Waikato, outside New Zealand's established geothermal areas. The Taranaki low-temperature project receives $3 million.

items.title: Task Force identifies opportunities to improve major electricity investment decisions
items.source: Commerce Commission / Energy Competition Task Force
items.summary: The Energy Competition Task Force reviewed EDB-initiated grid exit point (GXP) investments worth about $600–700m. It found weaknesses in demand forecasting and in how flexibility alternatives are tested, and is seeking feedback on whether more regulatory scrutiny is needed. Submissions close 5pm, 15 December.

items.title: Consultation on HPTI capacity equivalence legislative instrument opens
items.summary: The Clean Energy Regulator opened consultation on 2 November 2026 on a proposed legislative instrument supporting capacity equivalence assessments under the Hydrogen Production Tax Incentive.

items.title: Government backing iwi-led geothermal potential
items.summary: The Regional Infrastructure Fund is funding two iwi-led geothermal projects near Rotorua. This includes a $3.82 million loan towards the $5.53 million Ngāti Rangiteaorere exploration programme in the Tikitere-Ruahine field.

items.title: Reliability Framework for the Future NEM
items.summary: The AEMC has set up a new review (EPR0203) of the NEM reliability framework, with terms of reference pending. The outcome could reshape reliability settings and investment signals across the NEM.

items.title: RIF grant to support energy resilience in Far North
items.summary: The Government has given a $1.11 million Regional Infrastructure Fund grant to a Māori-led project putting solar power, battery storage and back-up generators into community facilities in the Far North. The aim is to make local energy supply more resilient and keep essential services running during outages.

items.title: ADVANCE NOTICE: Independent Technical Advisor for multiple Renewable Energy Projects
items.summary: MFAT advance notice of procurement for independent technical adviser(s) with renewable energy expertise across multiple projects. Closes 19 November 2026.

items.title: IN008-25 East Coast Gas Life Support Changes Consultation
items.summary: AEMO's proposed procedure change (IN008-25) implements the AEMC's Improving life support processes Rule 2026 No. 2 and the ESC's Victorian life support rule changes across east coast gas retail markets. Written submissions close 17 November 2026.

items.title: Biogas research to assist industry and policy decision-makers
items.summary: EECA is seeking a supplier to develop technical, commercial and environmental resources that address information gaps limiting investment in organic waste-to-energy (anaerobic digestion) projects in New Zealand. Proposals close 26 November 2026.

items.title: EOI Technical Consultancy Services Panel for Strategic Network Design & Engineering Services
items.summary: Orion is seeking expressions of interest from consultancies for a panel providing strategic network design and electrical engineering services to its Canterbury distribution network. Closes 27 November 2026.

items.title: Minor amendments to EIEP14A
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has made minor amendments to Electricity Information Exchange Protocol EIEP14A, which covers retail data exchange.

items.title: Australian portable battery manufacturing $6.8 m boost through ARENA
items.summary: ARENA has given $6.77 million to Clutch Industries for a $19.35 million project to build a scalable manufacturing line in Coburg North, Victoria. The line will make its PowerNet modular 4 kWh portable batteries, which can also be combined into a home battery system.

items.title: Neoen secures AUD 1.8 billion in debt financing to support renewable energy portfolio in Australia
items.summary: The CEFC has committed up to $100 million to Neoen's $1.8 billion portfolio debt financing, which is backed by 13 lenders. The financing covers 1.2 GW of assets: Hornsdale Power Reserve, Goyder South Wind Farm Stage 1A, Culcairn Solar Farm and Battery, and the Narrogin Wind Farm in WA.

items.title: FESO 2027 - Draft Methodology, Scenarios and Assumptions
items.summary: DEED has moved to the draft modelling, inputs, scenarios and assumptions stage of the Future Energy System Outlook 2027, the scenario-based plan for the SWIS to 2050 that serves as the Whole of System Plan under the ESM Rules. Stakeholders can comment on the draft MISA during the public consultation period.

items.title: New Electricity Rules Version 255
items.summary: On 29 October 2026 the AEMC published version 255 of the National Electricity Rules, which incorporates Schedule 4 of the Improving Compensation Frameworks Rule 2026 No. 9.

items.title: Non-Co-optimised Essential System Services Review - Exposure Draft
items.summary: DEED has published the final outcomes of the NCESS Framework Review and an Exposure Draft of ESM Amending Rules, including a shorter procurement process for repeat Western Power network support services and fewer barriers for aggregated distribution-connected storage. Submissions on the Exposure Draft closed on 29 October 2026.

items.title: Real-Time Data Consultation (Package 1) – Final Determination
items.summary: AEMO has published its final determination on retail electricity market procedure changes to implement the AEMC's Real-Time Data for Consumers rule, including a new Real-Time Data Procedure and RTD Authorised Recipient accreditation arrangements. Changes take effect in stages from 26 November 2026, 2 May 2027 and 30 November 2028.

items.title: $6M roll-out of early fault detection to regional areas
items.summary: Western Power has started a $6 million roll-out of about 100 Early Fault Detection Devices on regional feeders with reliability problems, funded through its $88 million Regional Connect program. The roll-out is due to finish by the end of 2027.

items.title: ARENA Launchpad Program – Ecosystem Funding Round
items.summary: ARENA's Launchpad Ecosystem Funding Round is offering up to $15 million, with grants of up to $5 million for accelerators, incubators and other partners supporting clean energy startups. The Startup Round closed on 28 October 2026, but the Ecosystem Round stays open until the funding runs out.

items.title: Consultation on Western Australia’s adoption of the National Gas Law – Gas Pipelines Package
items.summary: DEED has released a consultation package on WA's intention to amend the National Gas Access (WA) Law by adopting relevant amendments from the national Gas Pipelines Package. Pipeline owners and users in WA should review the draft instruments.

items.title: Future Security and Resilience roadmap update
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has released an update on activities in its 2022 Future Security and Resilience roadmap, including revised timelines for selected workstreams. Feedback is invited on the updated roadmap.

items.title: Electricity Information Exchange Protocols 13C and 14C electronic request formats decision
items.summary: The Authority has decided to update the EIEP13C electronic request format for consumption data. It is also introducing a new EIEP14C format that lets consumers request their product data, such as which plan they are on.

items.title: Singapore and New Zealand to strengthen bilateral energy co-operation
items.summary: The Electricity Authority and Singapore's Energy Market Authority signed a Memorandum of Arrangements to cooperate on electricity market planning and regulation and on integrating low-carbon technologies. The agreement covers staff training, joint research and knowledge sharing.

items.title: Plan for Affordable Energy to support WA jobs and businesses
items.source: WA Government (Premier / Minister for Energy and Decarbonisation)
items.summary: The WA Government has released its Plan for Affordable Energy, which includes a target of 75% renewable generation on the SWIS by 2030-31, continued domestic gas reservation and a future gas security strategy, and transitional measures so consumers do not overpay for reserve capacity. Government modelling says industrial electricity costs could rise 89% by 2032 without these measures.

items.title: Applications open for the Made in WA Energy Affordability Investment Program
items.source: Department of Energy and Economic Diversification
items.summary: A $153.3 million low-interest loan program offering $300,000 to $15 million to WA manufacturers for energy efficiency, on-site solar and storage, electrification and network connection works, across two streams. Applications close 5pm AWST on 23 February 2027.

items.title: Data centre contracting obligation for firmed energy
items.summary: The AEMC received a rule change request (ERC0461) on 20 October 2026 that proposes requiring data centres to contract for firmed energy. The project is at the pending stage, before formal consultation starts.

items.title: Connections framework enhancements for integrated facilities, co-located plant and flexible loads
items.summary: The AEMC received a rule change request (ERC0462) on 20 October 2026 to improve the NEM connections framework for integrated facilities, co-located plant and flexible loads. The project is at the pending stage.

items.title: NSW Roadmap - Tender Round 10 (Generation Infrastructure)
items.summary: AEMO Services is preparing NSW Roadmap Tender Round 10, seeking an indicative 2.5 GW of generation capacity with Generation and Hybrid Generation LTESA products. Registrations are expected to open in November/December 2026.

items.title: Gas Market Parameters Review 2026
items.summary: AEMO has published the final report of its 2026 review of Short Term Trading Market gas market parameters, completing consultation that ran until 7 August 2026.

items.title: DCET-NTSOLAR: Defence – Northern Territory Solar Farms Operation and Maintenance Market Sounding
items.summary: Department of Defence market sounding (EOI) for operation and maintenance services at Northern Territory solar farms, valued at $4–8 million over 2027–2032. Responses close 20 November 2026.

items.title: Code changes to address common quality issues
items.summary: The Authority has made a package of targeted common quality Code amendments to help maintain the security and resilience of the power system. The changes affect the technical obligations of grid-connected assets.

items.title: IPRR Trial Participation Guidelines consultation
items.summary: AEMO has released an approach paper on Stage 1 trial participation arrangements for the 'dispatch mode' framework under the Integrating Price-Responsive Resources rule, after resetting its delivery path in April 2026. An industry information session was set for 10 November 2026 and submissions close 27 November 2026, with draft guidelines expected by March 2027.

items.title: Quarterly Energy Dynamics Q3 2026
items.summary: AEMO's Q3 2026 QED shows NEM spot prices averaging $63/MWh (down 27% year-on-year), with batteries setting prices in 48% of intervals and out-supplying gas in the evening peak for the first time. In the WEM, the average real-time price hit a record $120.72/MWh as coal and wind availability fell, while FCESS costs dropped 98%.

items.title: Latham Disconnected Microgrd (DMG) Pilot - WP2600183
items.summary: Western Power is seeking expressions of interest from suppliers able to design, build, commission, operate and maintain a fully integrated disconnected microgrid for its pilot at Latham in the Shire of Perenjori. EOIs close at 2pm AWST on 13 November 2026, with an RFP/RFT expected in early 2027.

items.title: Joint media release: Update on Snowy 2.0
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: Ministers Bowen and Gallagher have issued a joint update on the Snowy 2.0 pumped hydro project. Relevant to NEM storage and reliability outlooks.

items.title: Long-duration firming: ensuring New Zealand's electricity system can weather the long haul
items.summary: The Authority's issues and options paper on long-duration firming seeks views on five options: regular reporting on firming needs, more transparent firming contracts, guidance, standardised contracts and a possible small mandated sell-side auction. Submissions close at 5pm on 13 November 2026.

items.title: Joint media release: Kimberley Communities Solar Saver delivers more than $240,000 in savings
items.summary: Horizon Power has finished rolling out the jointly funded Kimberley Communities Solar Saver shared-solar program, which installed about 1.5 MW of rooftop solar across six remote communities. Around 480 households now receive energy-saving credits, worth more than $240,000 so far.

items.title: TasNetworks PACR: Meeting Network Planning Requirements at George Town
items.summary: AEMO has published TasNetworks' Project Assessment Conclusions Report on meeting network planning requirements at George Town in Tasmania, dated 21 October 2026.

items.title: Battery projects drive record NEM connections pipeline
items.summary: AEMO's quarterly Connections Scorecard shows 80.9 GW of generation and storage progressing through the NEM connection process, 43% higher year-on-year, with batteries more than half of the pipeline. 23 projects (4.5 GW) received application approval and four projects (1 GW) connected in the September quarter.

items.title: Shortlist consultation: Waikato Regional Interconnection Capacity (WRIC) project
items.summary: Transpower is seeking feedback on the shortlist of options for the Waikato Regional Interconnection Capacity project, a grid upgrade to address growing demand in the Waikato region. Submissions close 2 December 2026.

items.title: Heat batteries pilot to help electrify Australian industry
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: The Federal Government, through ARENA, is backing a major heat battery project at Rio Tinto's Yarwun alumina refinery in Gladstone. It will be Australia's largest demonstration of industrial heat electrification using thermal energy storage.

items.title: Powercor RIT-T PACR: Terang Supply Area
items.summary: AEMO has published Powercor's Project Assessment Conclusions Report under the RIT-T for the Terang supply area in Victoria, dated 20 October 2026.

items.title: AEMO EGM speech at High Temperature Minerals Processing (HiTeMP) Forum
items.summary: Executive General Manager System Design Nicola Falcon set out 2026 ISP demand forecasts, including consumption nearly doubling to 390 TWh by 2050 and household grid demand falling 44% as consumers self-supply. Also flagged AEMO's joint work with the Commonwealth on a Demand-side Statement of Opportunities.

items.title: Call for nominations for the Security and Reliability Council
items.summary: The Electricity Authority is calling for nominations for three members of the Security and Reliability Council, which advises the Authority on security of supply and system reliability. A reminder issued on 3 November said nominations close soon.

items.title: ARENA powers Australia’s largest commercial vehicle-to-grid fleet deployment
items.summary: ARENA has awarded $4 million to JET Charge for Australia's largest commercial vehicle-to-grid deployment, which will test how EV fleets can support the electricity grid.

items.title: National EV charging roadmap project
items.summary: The Electric Vehicle Council is leading a national EV charging roadmap, backed by $1.06 million from ARENA's Driving the Nation Program, to map charging demand, network pressure points and priority infrastructure out to 2035. The roadmap is due mid-2027 and will inform government and network investment planning for passenger and heavy vehicles.

items.title: 50,000 social housing homes supported with cleaner, cheaper energy
items.summary: More than 50,000 social housing properties have received energy performance upgrades through the Social Housing Energy Performance Initiative (SHEPI). Provides a read on the scale of federally funded energy efficiency delivery.

items.title: 2600800 Renewable Energy Development
items.summary: Environment Canterbury is calling for information from parties able to lease West Melton Reserve land to develop and operate a solar or mixed solar/farming project. Responses close 27 November 2026.

items.title: Call for nominations: Distribution connection pricing technical group
items.summary: The Authority is seeking nominations for new members of its independent technical group, which supports its work to improve distribution connection pricing.

items.title: Addressing System Strength Requirements in Queensland from December 2025 – Draft MCC Assessment
items.summary: Powerlink has published a Draft Material Change in Circumstances Assessment for its system strength RIT-T, reassessing the identified need and preferred option after changes to Queensland coal unit retirement dates. Submissions close 30 November 2026 and a final statement is due by 9 December 2026.

items.title: Consultation on Proposed Changes to Compensation Methodology for Hybrid Facilities
items.summary: AEMO is running an expedited consultation to amend the Methodology for AEMO Intervention Event Compensation so that single-DUID hybrid systems (for example solar plus battery registered as a bidirectional unit) get a $0/MWh direct cost in upfront compensation calculations. Participants can still claim additional compensation. Submissions are due 13 November 2026 and the final report is expected o…

items.title: Quarterly Carbon Market Report – September Quarter 2026 (data release)
items.summary: The Clean Energy Regulator published September Quarter 2026 data on ACCU issuance and demand, LRET and Renewable Electricity Guarantee of Origin uptake, and rooftop solar and battery installation. The full analysis report is expected by mid-December 2026.

items.title: Solar Sunshot – Round 3: Supporting advanced manufacturing and deployment
items.summary: Round 3 of ARENA's Solar Sunshot program offers up to $250 million for commercial-scale manufacture of solar balance-of-plant and deployment technologies such as racking, tracking, robotics and prefabrication. Expressions of interest opened on 2 November 2026 and close 12 November 2027, with full applications due 12 April 2028.

items.title: AEPC_2026_07 Dispatch Algorithm Formulation
items.summary: AEMO has published a revised Procedure Change Proposal (version 2) and draft WEM Procedure: Dispatch Algorithm Formulation v5.2, covering updated constraint violation penalties, RoCoF Control Service requirements, droop response estimates and an initial tranche of Coordinator of Energy WEM Procedure Content Review recommendations. Submissions close 5pm AWST 13 November 2026, with commencement pro…

items.title: Renewable investment hits highest level in history under Albanese Government
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: The Minister cites new Clean Energy Regulator data showing final investment decisions for large-scale renewable generation have reached record levels.

items.title: ARENA seeks local and global solar innovators for $250 million solar manufacturing round
items.summary: ARENA has launched Round 3 of the Solar Sunshot program, offering up to $250 million for commercial-scale manufacturing of solar balance-of-plant and deployment technologies such as racking, trackers and robotics. Expressions of interest opened on 2 November 2026.

items.title: Clean Energy Link - East powers local jobs with major contract award
items.summary: Contracts for stage one of Clean Energy Link - East (Collie–Darkan transmission works, including a new 330kV terminal at Cordering) were awarded to Acciona, GenusPlus and UGL, with about 2.3GW of renewable capacity expected to be unlocked. Western Power also reported spending more than $1.3 billion with local WA businesses in 2025-26.

items.title: Authority discontinues alleged Code breaches at Waipipi Wind Farm
items.summary: The Electricity Authority has discontinued its investigations into alleged Code breaches by Genesis Energy and Waverley Wind Farm Limited at Waipipi Wind Farm.

items.title: Next steps for MOSP 10-year roadmap
items.summary: After consultation, the Authority will update data-sharing and governance arrangements before considering any structural reform of market operation service provider services. Data interface upgrades will follow the start of the new MOSP contracts in July 2027 and will align with MBIE's consumer data right work.

items.title: Joint media release: Landmark legislation to secure Australian gas for industry and households
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: Ministers Bowen and King have announced legislation aimed at securing Australian gas supply for domestic industry and households. It is a major Commonwealth gas market policy decision affecting producers, retailers and large users.

items.title: Draft 2027 General Power System Risk Review approach paper consultation
items.summary: AEMO is consulting on the draft 2027 GPSRR approach paper, which sets out the priority low-probability, high-impact risks and the methodology and assumptions for the 2027 review. Submissions close 12 November 2026, with the final approach paper due in December.

items.title: 2026-27 Review of the Safeguard Mechanism
items.summary: The 2026-27 review of the Safeguard Mechanism is examining the 2030-35 baseline decline rate, coverage, the future role of SMCs, ACCUs and international units, and trade-exposed settings. Submissions to the consultation paper have closed; policy positions and draft rule amendments are expected in early 2027.

items.title: AEMO CEO Speech at 2026 AFR Energy and Climate Summit
items.summary: AEMO's CEO said transmission-connected battery capacity in the NEM has doubled in 12 months to more than 9 GW. The CEO also noted that WA's main grid now has almost 1.5 GW of batteries, more than a third of peak summer demand.

items.title: Backing Australian industry with expanded emissions certification
items.summary: The Guarantee of Origin Scheme now covers emissions certification for aluminium, iron ore, biogas, biomethane and more hydrogen production pathways, including gas reforming, solid gasification and pyrolysis. The Government is also consulting on adding low-carbon liquid fuels, iron, alumina and ammonia.

items.title: Australian-made solar robots move towards commercial scale with $31.1 million in ARENA funding
items.summary: ARENA is providing up to $31.1 million under Solar Sunshot Round 2 to establish solar robotics manufacturing facilities in Melbourne and Brisbane, aimed at speeding up the construction of large-scale solar farms.

items.title: Joint media release: Lower energy bills for more WA social housing tenants
items.summary: A new $53.9 million Commonwealth investment under the Social Housing Energy Performance Initiative will put ceiling insulation into more than 4,000 more social housing properties in regional and remote WA over five years. This brings the total number of WA homes funded for upgrades to around 8,000.

items.title: Carbon Innovation Grants Program – Round 3
items.source: Department of Water and Environmental Regulation (WA)
items.summary: Round 3 of WA's Carbon Innovation Grants Program offers about $3.1 million for heavy industry decarbonisation feasibility studies ($50k–$500k) and pilot or capital works projects ($100k–$1.5m). Applications close at 5pm AWST on 11 December 2026.

items.title: Operational Forecasting Review
items.summary: DEED and AEMO are reviewing AEMO's operational forecasting processes in the WEM. Relevant to market participants who depend on AEMO's operational demand and supply forecasts.

items.title: 2026 Benchmark Technology Review – Draft Determination for consultation
items.summary: The Coordinator of Energy's draft determination on the Benchmark Peak and Flexible Technologies and the CONE approach for setting Benchmark Reserve Capacity Prices follows AEMO's increase of the storage duration requirement from 6 to 7 hours. Submissions closed on 7 October 2026 and 18 stakeholder submissions are now published.

items.title: Review of security of supply standards
items.summary: The Authority proposes updating the methodology for the Winter Capacity Margin and NZ Winter Energy Margin, which would include modelling batteries as new peak capacity, and removing the South Island Winter Energy Margin. It also proposes interim changes to the Security Standards Assumptions Document for the 2027 Security of Supply Assessment. Submissions close 17 November 2026.

items.title: $7.29 million to strengthen Pacific energy security
items.source: Federal Minister for Climate Change and Energy
items.summary: The Australian Government has announced a $7.29 million package to speed up renewables rollout in the Pacific, along with a new energy cooperation agreement.

items.title: Project EnergyConnect prepares to connect three NEM regions
items.summary: AEMO update on progressively bringing Project EnergyConnect into operation, increasing energy transfers between New South Wales, Victoria and South Australia as conditions allow testing. The interconnector is a significant factor in NEM flow patterns and regional price outcomes.

items.title: Improving incentives for long-duration firming
items.summary: The Electricity Authority is seeking feedback on whether and how to strengthen market settings to support efficient supply of long-duration firm energy. The work sits under its managing peak electricity demand project and could affect investment signals for firming and storage.

items.title: RIT-T PSCR - Thomastown Terminal Capacity Constraint
items.source: AEMO / Jemena Electricity Networks and AusNet
items.summary: Jemena and AusNet have published a Project Specification Consultation Report on options to maintain supply reliability and connect new major load in the Thomastown Terminal Station area of Melbourne. They are seeking non-network and SAPS proposals, with submissions due 22 December 2026.

items.title: AEPC_2026_17 Commissioning Tests
items.summary: AEMO's amended WEM Procedure: Commissioning Tests lets AEMO seek Network Operator advice when assessing Commissioning Test Plans and clarifies how reactive power studies are considered. AEMO lists the amended procedure as commencing on 2 November 2026.

items.title: Power System Security and Reliability Standards Review – Exposure Draft
items.summary: The Coordinator of Energy's PSSR Standards Review has reached the exposure draft stage, implementing a single end-to-end security and reliability standard for the SWIS under the ESM Rules. It covers network planning standards, connection technical requirements for inverter-based resources, system strength and governance.

items.title: Consultation on proposed changes to the Gas Access Funding Regulations and Local Provisions Regulations
items.summary: The Department of Energy and Economic Diversification wants feedback on proposed amendments to the ERA (National Gas Access Funding) Regulations 2009 and the National Gas Access (WA) (Local Provisions) Regulations 2009. The changes affect how gas access regulation is funded and administered in WA.

items.title: AES Code of Practice for Single Property Network Services Consultation
items.summary: Consultation on the Alternative Electricity Services Code of Practice for single property network services has closed.

items.title: Consultation opens on 'balcony solar' in WA
items.summary: DEED and LGIRS are consulting on legalising plug-in solar and battery systems in WA, via a regulatory amendment and a new technical standard allowing up to 2 kW (DC) of panels and 800 W (AC) inverters, with no cap on storage. Feedback closes 5pm AWST on 9 December 2026.

items.title: Consumer Energy National Technical Regulatory Framework
items.summary: Energy Ministers endorsed the Consumer Energy National Technical Regulatory Framework, which will establish a National CER Technical Code and obligations for suppliers and installers of consumer energy assets such as solar, batteries and flexible loads. It is a key step towards nationally consistent technical requirements for CER devices.

items.title: Reliability and System Strength Services for the North Country - WS5659204351
items.summary: Western Power is calling for Non-Co-optimised Essential System Services (NCESS) submissions for reliability and system strength services around the Rangeway, Geraldton and Chapman substations, triggered by the Coordinator of Energy under the WEM Rules. The long-term option (10–25 years) closes 5pm AWST 1 February 2027, with questions due 11 January 2027; the short-term option closed 12 October 20…

items.title: Synergy fined for breach of wholesale energy rules
items.summary: The ERA has fined Synergy $1.2 million after finding it breached the rules governing Western Australia's Wholesale Electricity Market. It is a significant enforcement action against the dominant WEM participant.

items.title: Making it easier to connect solar, batteries and EV chargers – Issues paper on DER data and connections
items.summary: Energy Policy WA issues paper setting out seven proposals to improve DER data and connections for solar, batteries and EV chargers in the SWIS. The consultation has closed.

items.title: Consultation on proposed amendments Electricity Generation and Retail Corporation (EGRC) Scheme’s Wholesale Arrangements
items.summary: Exposure draft of amendments to the EGRC Scheme's Wholesale Arrangements, putting into effect the ERA's 2025 review recommendations on how Synergy publishes its standard product pricing and on buy-side restrictions for entities with market power. Consultation closed on 9 June 2026; the amendments will then go to the Minister for Energy to be made.

items.title: Electricity Flexibility Solutions - Upper Clutha Area
items.summary: Aurora Energy is inviting registrations of interest from providers of DER, flexible demand and distributed generation to help manage demand and voltage constraints in the fast-growing Upper Clutha area. This is the pre-qualification stage of a two-stage process and stays open until 29 December 2028.

items.title: Solar for Apartment Residents (SoAR) Grant Program
items.summary: NSW owners corporations can apply for up to $150,000 (50% co-funding) to install shared rooftop solar on apartment buildings, funded through the Commonwealth Community Solar Banks Program. Applications close at 5pm on 4 December 2026 and projects must be finished by 30 April 2027.
